{'text': '蘋果軟件工程高級副總裁 Craig Federighi 今個星期同 MKBHD 坐低傾咗偈，討論新出嘅 iPhone Duo。訪問入面，Federighi 提到咗 iPhone Duo 同 iPad 之間可能存在嘅功能重疊。', 'translatetext': "Apple's Senior Vice President of Software Engineering, Craig Federighi, sat down with MKBHD this week to discuss the newly released iPhone Duo. During the interview, Federighi mentioned the potential feature overlap between the iPhone Duo and the iPad."}

{'text': 'Craig Federighi：iPad 定 iPhone Duo？', 'translatetext': 'Craig Federighi: iPad or iPhone Duo?'}

{'text': 'Federighi 將呢個情況類比 iPad 同 Mac，話用家最終會根據「好自然嘅使用習慣」去決定幾時用 iPad、幾時用 Mac。Federighi 相信 iPad 同 iPhone Duo 之間都會出現同樣嘅模式，', 'translatetext': "Federighi drew a parallel between this situation and that of the iPad and Mac, saying that users will eventually decide when to use an iPad and when to use a Mac based on 'very natural usage habits.' Federighi believes the same pattern will emerge between the iPad and iPhone Duo,"}

{'text': '不過，佢特別提到 iPad mini 可能會同 iPhone Duo 形成競爭：', 'translatetext': 'However, he specifically noted that the iPad mini might compete with the iPhone Duo:'}

{'text': '「我發現自己呢幾個月嘅使用習慣係，如果我本來用緊 iPhone，坐低之後其實想再深入睇啲內容，想讀啲嘢，呢部機展開嚟真係好好用，好多時仲要直度拎住佢揭頁，睇內容一流。我覺得用家會搵到適合自己嘅用法。不過我都同意，對於以前可能用緊 iPad mini 嘅人嚟講，呢部機好多時都可以填補到嗰個位置。」', 'translatetext': "'I've found that my usage pattern over the past few months is, if I'm using my iPhone and then sit down wanting to engage with content more deeply, wanting to read something, this device unfolded is really great to use — often held vertically to flip through pages, it's excellent for consuming content. I think users will find the usage that suits them. But I do agree that for people who might previously have been using an iPad mini, this device can often fill that role.'"}

{'text': '正如大家對一位軟件工程主管嘅期望，Federighi 亦提到蘋果喺將 iOS 體驗調整至適配 iPhone Duo 方面所落嘅功夫——尤其係同其他競爭對手比較嘅時候。', 'translatetext': 'As one would expect from a head of software engineering, Federighi also mentioned the work Apple has put into adapting the iOS experience to fit the iPhone Duo — particularly when compared to other competitors.'}

{'text': 'Federighi 解釋：「好多其他裝置嘅做法係，『我哋只係將原本嘅體驗拉大或者塞入去個新嘅外型就算』。我哋嘅做法就係：『成件事，我哋要由零開始重新設計』。」', 'translatetext': 'Federighi explained: \'The approach with a lot of other devices is, "We\'ll just stretch or fit the existing experience into a new form factor and call it a day." Our approach is: "We\'re going to redesign the whole thing from scratch."\''}

{'text': '大家可以喺下面睇 MKBHD 嘅完整訪問片段。你對 Federighi 對 iPhone Duo 嘅解釋有咩睇法？下個月會唔會打算預訂一部？歡迎喺留言區分享你嘅意見。', 'translatetext': "You can watch the full interview with MKBHD below.
